_doc: Scope: every stylesheet the terminal import walk (pages/terminal/__tests__/themeScope.js) reaches outside pages/terminal and components/terminal.
count = text RULES (rule + prop, worst theme/surface) under WCAG AA in any of the 21 themes, incl. rules the rail cannot read.
SHRINK-ONLY: a file may never gain a failing rule, and a file not listed must have none. When a rule is fixed, lower its count here in the same commit (the rail reds until you do).
Gain/loss text (var(--loss)/var(--gain) as color or SVG text fill) is NOT baselineable: the rail requires zero. Fix it with --danger-ink / --success-ink.
